notes: There is no build step: the repo has no package.json, so the deploy command runs wrangler directly from the repo root against wrangler.jsonc.
The Workspace Durable Object namespace is provisioned as legacy-kv. Declaring it as sqlite fails the deploy with storage_type_mismatch; the storage type cannot be changed after creation.

Durable Objects are declared in wrangler.jsonc under exports, which is mutually exclusive with migrations. A class that is provisioned but missing from exports fails with provisioned_class_missing_from_config.
